rows.text: Esteemed guest, the Garmentmaker in "Bloodbathed Battlefront" can no longer detect any more nymphs
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: But a strange one appeared at the outpost
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Feel free to check it out at the Garmentmaker's if you're interested
rows.speaker: Aglaea
